title: Runbook: 24h Earthquake Count Spike
content:
Symptoms: 24h earthquake count significantly exceeds baseline.
Checks: Compute recent_count and 7-day baseline_avg.
Actions: Calculate ratio and check clustering.
Report: recent_count, baseline_avg, ratio.

title: Runbook: High Magnitude Event (>=6.0)
content:
Symptoms: At least one event magnitude >=6.0.
Checks: Filter magnitude >=6.0.
Actions: Monitor aftershocks and region.
Report: magnitude, depth_km, place.

title: Runbook: Multiple M5+ Events
content:
Symptoms: 3 or more events magnitude >=5.0 in 24h.
Checks: Count magnitude >=5.0.
Actions: Evaluate escalation risk.
Report: count_M5, max_magnitude.

title: Runbook: Shallow Earthquake Increase
content:
Symptoms: Increased shallow (<20km) proportion.
Checks: Compare shallow_ratio recent vs baseline.
Actions: Assess surface impact risk.
Report: shallow_ratio_recent, shallow_ratio_baseline.

title: Runbook: Regional Seismic Cluster
content:
Symptoms: Majority of events in single region.
Checks: Group by place.
Actions: Monitor dominant region.
Report: cluster_region, event_count.

title: Runbook: Offshore Event Surge
content:
Symptoms: Spike in offshore events.
Checks: Filter marine coordinates.
Actions: Assess tsunami potential.
Report: offshore_event_count.

title: Runbook: Magnitude Distribution Shift
content:
Symptoms: Increase in average magnitude.
Checks: Compute avg_mag recent vs baseline.
Actions: Assess escalation pattern.
Report: avg_mag_recent, avg_mag_baseline.

title: Runbook: Historical Major Events Review
content:
Symptoms: Request for strongest earthquakes in period.
Checks: Sort by magnitude DESC.
Actions: Analyze depth and region.
Report: top_events, max_magnitude.

title: Runbook: Baseline Comparison Framework
content:
Symptoms: Date vs 7-day comparison requested.
Checks: Compute target_count and baseline_avg.
Actions: Calculate ratio.
Report: target_count, baseline_avg, ratio.

title: Runbook: Time-of-Day Pattern
content:
Symptoms: Unusual hourly distribution.
Checks: Bucket by hour.
Actions: Validate reporting consistency.
Report: hour_distribution.

title: Runbook: Location Drift Detection
content:
Symptoms: Gradual epicenter shift.
Checks: Sort by timestamp and compare coordinates.
Actions: Evaluate fault propagation.
Report: drift_direction.

title: Runbook: Sensor Artifact Detection
content:
Symptoms: Burst with identical timestamps.
Checks: Inspect timestamp clustering.
Actions: Verify ingestion pipeline.
Report: suspicious_pattern.

title: Runbook: Non-Tectonic Event Check
content:
Symptoms: Isolated moderate event without aftershocks.
Checks: Verify follow-up events.
Actions: Cross-reference industrial activity.
Report: suspected_non_tectonic.

title: Runbook: Aftershock Sequence Monitoring
content:
Symptoms: Series of decreasing magnitude events.
Checks: Sort by magnitude over time.
Actions: Monitor decay pattern.
Report: aftershock_trend.

title: Runbook: Elevated Regional Risk Assessment
content:
Symptoms: Large event or abnormal cluster.
Checks: Validate magnitude, depth, clustering.
Actions: Assess escalation probability.
Report: severity_level, risk_outlook.
